conflicts.subject: parseBuiltinSkill metadata construction
conflicts.reason: The old eager module casts YAML metadata, so wrong/missing field types can pass through. Applying the new decoder to that in-process legacy path changes acceptance. The strict decoder is separately exposed; the eager legacy driver retains its original assertion and error construction. This is pending deletion, not a compiler exemption.

conflicts.subject: agentFailureFromCloudReason prototype-named reason lookup
conflicts.reason: A historical Record lookup inherits Object.prototype. The compatibility boundary preserves the original constructor/__proto__ results and explicit retryable override. Strict lookup uses own keys and produces schema-valid failure codes; no decoder is inserted into legacy calls.
